scheme_name: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits_summary: Academic allowance and tuition fee grant ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹20,000 per year for OBC, EBC, and DNT students pursuing post-secondary education.
application_steps: Log into the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Select PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship and upload academic and income proofs.
Submit copy of application to your school or college nodal officer.
